cover.desc: Full color, Layer 3 palette — cel shading, hard-edged shadows, pastel field, generous negative space. A flooded machine hall lit from one high window, ankle-deep water, pale green-grey palette. Kusaka Hibiki stands in the water in his dark zero jersey with one rusted iron bracket held up over his head in both hands like a trophy, mouth wide open in a shout, filthy and radiant, solid black hair the darkest mass in frame. Facing him across the water, mirrored exactly, a small grinning boy in a rust-orange Higashi Commercial jersey — Tsuchiya Ken, spiky mid-tone hair, one hand in his pocket and the other holding up the identical second bracket. Their reflections in the water make four brackets. Between them, hanging in the air like an official stamp, a plain white card reading nothing.

dialogue.text: Not in the Pit. Not to save her.
Kujō will try to make you.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: flat, and for one panel she looks tired
chars.pose: against the wall, hands in sleeves

panels.action: Nobody asks her why. Nobody has ever asked her why.

dialogue.text: Get some sleep, all of you.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: at the shed door, jersey over his shoulder, turning back

panels.bg: the shed door, night outside, the club packing up behind him
panels.action: Everyone goes home. He does the thing he always does at doorways.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: chibi, both hands out, radiant

chars.name: momo
chars.expression: chibi, slapping his palm

chars.name: gaku
chars.expression: chibi, resigned, offering a hand from four metres away

panels.action: Eight of them. Every night now.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: flat, watching from the far side of the room

panels.bg: the shed, the doorway out of focus
panels.action: Eight of nine. It is the same every night and she counts it every night.

panels.bg: outside the shed at night — the practice Pit a black bowl behind the fence, one security light, moths, the school buildings dark, the whole sports ground empty
panels.action: Half past nine. Everybody else has gone.

dialogue.text: And one person I can't use.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: flat, standing under the security light
chars.pose: both hands in her sleeves, absolutely still

panels.bg: the security light, moths, the fence
panels.action: She has been standing out here working out how to say it.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: genuinely surprised

panels.action: She does not change things. She has never changed a stated thing in her life.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: level, looking straight at him under the light

panels.bg: the security light, moths, the black bowl of the Pit
panels.action: She gives him the real instruction, and it is much worse.

chars.name: hibiki
chars.expression: grinning, but slowly, because he has understood the shape of it

panels.action: Two hundred people is not a plan. Two hundred people is a weapon.

chars.name: sumire
chars.expression: turning to go, and the last line lands over her shoulder
chars.pose: walking into the dark, one hand raised

panels.bg: the path away from the shed, night, borderless
panels.action: She does not explain. She never explains.
